search_notes: Unranked, with one entry per canonical upstream repository. Verified as of 2026-10-02 using gh api repos/OWNER/REPO, releases/latest and default-branch commit endpoints, plus upstream READMEs/model cards. Every included repository exists, reports archived=false and has a default-branch commit within the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-04. Repository release dates are labeled separately from model release dates. The DeepSeek-V3 and GLM-4.5 seeds failed the activity window; mistralai/mistral-inference reports archived=true. Hardware eligibility for 27–32B checkpoints assumes approximately 4-bit weights and bounded context/concurrency, with memory reserved for embeddings; this is a capacity estimate, and application-level tool-call reliability remains untested. The embedding model's memory requirement and laptop unified-memory capacities were unspecified. [llama-server documentation](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/tools/server/README.md) establishes a serving path with quantized GPU inference, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses endpoints, schema-constrained JSON and function calling. Used 30 GitHub API calls and eight successful page fetches. All six web-search attempts timed out, so exhaustive discovery could not be established within the budget.
